payload.title: Reject 50 percent U-surface projection
payload.decision: Reject T060's 50% U=TVT+Z projection despite aggregate gains because its frozen tail and repeated-family gates failed. Do not deploy or cosmetically retune the 50% action.
payload.rationale: Primary pooled RMSE gains do not override increased tail concentration or failed repeated-fold evidence. The structural mechanism remains worth one independently frozen lower-strength replication.
payload.revisit_trigger: Only a preregistered materially lower projection strength that passes every base, fold, spatial, tail, destructive-control, and bootstrap gate may continue.
